name: CrystaLLM
org: University of Bristol, University College London
one_liner: Autoregressive crystal language model with validity checks on generated CIFs, optional Monte Carlo tree search guided by a learned formation-energy network, and DFT on finished structures.

loop.proposes: A domain-trained transformer generates full CIF crystal descriptions conditioned on composition or space group.
loop.judged_by: Validity checks on generated CIFs; the optional Monte Carlo tree search is scored by a learned formation-energy network (ALIGNN); DFT is run on finished structures.
loop.steers: Optional Monte Carlo tree search guided by a learned formation-energy network steers generation.

headline_result: Rediscovered unseen experimental crystal structures and identified novel stable inorganic phases validated by ab initio DFT.
caveat: Struggles on very large unit cells (>60 atoms) where token context length and space-group Wyckoff constraints become tight.
beyond_harness_note: Validity checks on generated CIFs, a learned formation-energy network guiding optional tree search, and DFT on finished structures.
algorithmic_authority: CIF validity checks and a learned formation-energy network (ALIGNN); DFT on finished structures

sources.title: Crystal structure generation with autoregressive large language modeling (Nature Communications, 2024)

verification.notes: Checked against Antunes et al., Nature Communications 15, 2024.
